card.name: Small words before an amount or quantity
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as at, too, and, would, there or compared, just before a quantity or amount is stated. Typical phrases are "at least", "too much" and "more than".

modes.label: at least / too much
modes.description: The word "at" in "at least" or "too" in "too much", right before an amount word.
modes.example: every state is constitutionally guaranteed<< at>> least one seat.

modes.label: Comparison of counts
modes.description: A linking word that leads into a comparison or count of cases, such as "compared" or "there" before a number.
